risks: I could not read the 4.1.1 POM here (no local copy), so I did not check which dependencies the artifact pulls in transitively. If the build cannot resolve spring-boot-test, spring-test, micrometer-core or spring-boot-micrometer-metrics, add them explicitly at the same 4.1.1 version.

Meaningful coverage probably needs a Spring Boot context, so the tests may also need spring-boot-test-autoconfigure or spring-boot-actuator-autoconfigure at 4.1.1. These are already used by sibling projects. Local Gradle and Native Image verification will show whether they are required.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: No concrete evidence of extra setup. The artifact is a small test-support module (@AutoConfigureMetrics, @AutoConfigureObservability and related test-slice helpers). It needs no Docker image, environment variable or system property. The sibling spring-boot-micrometer-metrics project under tests/src uses only the library, spring-boot-actuator and assertj.
